name: Xing4.0-29B-A4B

lineage.how_derived: trained end to end on a domestic in-house stack (NPU clusters); 1.5T bilingual tokens per the card; an Intent variant (Xing4.0-29B-Intent) also exists

purpose: Agentic MoE flagship that moves from answering questions to getting things done: long-context planning, multi-step reasoning, tool calling and structured output (card).

license.name: Apache-2.0
license.notes: Apache License 2.0 text read in the repo LICENSE file: commercial use, modification and redistribution allowed with notice and patent grant.

architecture.kind: MoE with MLA attention, manifold-constrained hyper-connections (mHC) and MTP

variants.notes: iq3_m 15.45, iq2_M-slim 11.8, q5_0 20.42, q6_k 26.88, q8_0 34.16 GB; no Q4_K_M listed; llama.cpp b12174 or later per card

pc-12gb.notes: 18.27 GB file against 9.6 GB VRAM plus 50 GB RAM budget; experts stream from RAM (~4 B active, decode bound by RAM bandwidth)

pc-16gb.notes: 18.27 GB file against 13.6 GB VRAM plus 50 GB RAM budget; experts stream from RAM (~4 B active, decode bound by RAM bandwidth)

pc-24gb.notes: 18.27 GB file fits the VRAM budget (21.6 GB) with room for KV

pc-32gb.notes: 18.27 GB file fits the VRAM budget (29.6 GB) with room for KV

mac-16-24gb.notes: 18.27 GB file against a GPU share of about 12 GB (KV cache not included)

mac-32gb.notes: 18.27 GB file against a GPU share of about 22 GB (KV cache not included)

mac-64gb+.notes: 18.27 GB file against a GPU share of about 52 GB (KV cache not included)

engine_support.notes: Card requires llama.cpp b12174 or later; mHC and MLA make it a non-trivial architecture for a new engine.

strengths: agent-format alignment with common coding-agent harnesses per the card
weaknesses: compares against Qwen3.6-35B-A3B and Gemma 4 26B, not the newer Qwen3.8-27B
soft.maturity: China Telecom's TeleChat lineage; only 5.7k downloads of the main repo but 1.87k likes and 24k downloads of a community GGUF

tona_fit.reason: On the vendor table it is on par with Qwen3.6-35B-A3B on coding agents (SWE-bench Verified 75.0 vs 76.0, Terminal-Bench 2.1 higher), which our reference already serves, while Qwen3.8-27B and Flint now set the bar. Apache-2.0 (text read). Worth a test only if the MLA/mHC path is cheap to add.

open_questions: quality of the official GGUF quants
